info.title: OpenSearch REST API (search and documents)
info.description: Trimmed by hand from opensearch-project/opensearch-api-specification (release main-latest, opensearch-openapi.yaml, info.version 0.3.0, x-api-version 2.16.0, read 2026-11-01) to the document and search routes the provider's bindings need; STACKIT publishes no document for this API. Changes from the source, all to describe the wire: OpenAPI 3.1 `oneOf: [null, ...]` is 3.0 `nullable`; one route per operation, keeping the POST or PUT form; the query DSL, aggregations, highlight, suggest and collapse stay open objects, because the source's recursive types are thousands of lines and a caller writes them as JSON anyway; `hits.total` is only the object form, because the integer form needs `rest_total_hits_as_int`, which isn't exposed; `refresh` is its string spellings; deprecated `_type` fields are gone; `_bulk`'s NDJSON body is one preserialized string (see the `bulk` patch). The error responses, which the source models only as a generic 4XX, are in this file as 400, 401 and 403; the 404 and 409 tags come from a patch. Bodies and status codes were checked by running each request against the opensearchproject/opensearch:2 image (OpenSearch 2.19.7), read 2026-11-01. STACKIT's own instances have not been probed; which OpenSearch version a plan runs is what its offering says.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Name of the index. Search accepts a comma-separated list and wildcards, such as `logs-*`.

parameters.name: allow_no_indices
parameters.description: If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.

parameters.name: expand_wildcards
parameters.description: Type of index that wildcard patterns can match. Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.

parameters.name: ignore_unavailable
parameters.description: If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.

parameters.name: preference
parameters.description: Nodes and shards used for the search. Random by default.

parameters.name: routing
parameters.description: A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.

parameters.name: search_pipeline
parameters.description: Customizable sequence of processing stages applied to search queries.

parameters.name: search_type
parameters.description: How distributed term frequencies are calculated for relevance scoring.

post.summary: Adds a document to an index under an id OpenSearch generates.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Name of the index. Search accepts a comma-separated list and wildcards, such as `logs-*`.

parameters.name: pipeline
parameters.description: ID of the pipeline to use to preprocess incoming documents. If the index has a default ingest pipeline specified, then setting the value to `_none` disables the default ingest pipeline for this request.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: If `true`, OpenSearch refreshes the affected shards to make this operation visible to search, if `wait_for` then wait for a refresh to make this operation visible to search, if `false` do nothing with refreshes.

parameters.name: routing
parameters.description: A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Period the request waits for automatic index creation, dynamic mapping updates, and active shards, such as `30s`.

put.summary: Creates or updates a document in an index.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Name of the index. Search accepts a comma-separated list and wildcards, such as `logs-*`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the document.

parameters.name: if_primary_term
parameters.description: Only perform the operation if the document has this primary term.

parameters.name: if_seq_no
parameters.description: Only perform the operation if the document has this sequence number.

parameters.name: op_type
parameters.description: Set to `create` to only index the document if it does not already exist. If a document with the specified id already exists, the operation fails with `VersionConflict`.

parameters.name: pipeline
parameters.description: ID of the pipeline to use to preprocess incoming documents. If the index has a default ingest pipeline specified, then setting the value to `_none` disables the default ingest pipeline for this request.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: If `true`, OpenSearch refreshes the affected shards to make this operation visible to search, if `wait_for` then wait for a refresh to make this operation visible to search, if `false` do nothing with refreshes.

parameters.name: routing
parameters.description: A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Period the request waits for automatic index creation, dynamic mapping updates, and active shards, such as `30s`.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Name of the index. Search accepts a comma-separated list and wildcards, such as `logs-*`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the document.

parameters.name: _source
parameters.description: `true` or `false` to return the `_source` field or not, or a comma-separated list of fields to return.

parameters.name: _source_excludes
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude in the response.

parameters.name: _source_includes
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.

parameters.name: preference
parameters.description: Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on. Random by default.

parameters.name: realtime
parameters.description: If `true`, the request is real time as opposed to near real time.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: If `true`, OpenSearch refreshes the affected shards to make this operation visible to search.

parameters.name: routing
parameters.description: Target the specified primary shard.

parameters.name: stored_fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of stored fields to return.

post.summary: Allows to perform multiple index, create, update and delete operations in a single request. A failed action doesn't fail the request: check `errors` and each item.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Name of the index. Search accepts a comma-separated list and wildcards, such as `logs-*`.

parameters.name: pipeline
parameters.description: ID of the pipeline to use to preprocess incoming documents. If the index has a default ingest pipeline specified, then setting the value to `_none` disables the default ingest pipeline for this request.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: If `true`, OpenSearch refreshes the affected shards to make this operation visible to search, if `wait_for` then wait for a refresh to make this operation visible to search, if `false` do nothing with refreshes.

parameters.name: routing
parameters.description: A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Period the request waits for automatic index creation, dynamic mapping updates, and active shards, such as `30s`.

parameters.name: require_alias
parameters.description: If `true`, the request's actions must target an index alias.

query.description: The query, in OpenSearch's query DSL. Omit it to match every document.

from.description: Starting document offset. By default, you cannot page through more than 10,000 hits using `from` and `size`; use `search_after` beyond that.

sort.description: Sort order: field names, or objects such as `{ "timestamp": "desc" }`.

_source.description: `false` to leave the document out of each hit, or the list of fields to return.

fields.description: Field patterns to return under each hit's `fields`.

aggregations.description: The aggregations that are run as part of the search request, by name.

post_filter.description: A filter applied to the hits after aggregations are computed.

search_after.description: The `sort` values of the last hit of the previous page.

track_total_hits.description: `true` to count every match, `false` to skip counting (then `hits.total` is absent), or the number to count up to.

collapse.description: Collapse the hits by a field's value.

terminate_after.description: Maximum number of documents to collect for each shard.

timeout.description: How long to wait for a response from each shard, such as `30s`.

seq_no_primary_term.description: If `true`, returns the sequence number and primary term of the last modification of each hit.

version.description: If `true`, returns the document version as part of a hit.

reason.description: A human-readable explanation of the error, in English.

caused_by.description: The error's cause, in the same shape.

ErrorResponse.description: The base structure for error responses.

error.description: The error: an object, or a string on some security plugin failures.

_score.description: Relevance score; `null` when sorting by something else.

sort.description: The sort values; pass the last hit's to `search_after`.

matched_queries.description: Names of the named queries that matched.

WriteResponse.description: The base response for write operations.

status.description: HTTP status code returned for the action.

BulkResponseItem.description: One action's result, under the action's name.

errors.description: `true` if at least one action failed.
